name: Tavexia Lifecare Limited
summary: Sattva Sukun Lifecare Limited manufactures and trades in burners in India. The company engages in buying, selling, exporting, importing, processing, converting, laminating re process, and dealing in all models, shapes, sizes, capacities, and varieties of burner and other products. Its product portfolio includes kapoor and ceramic kapoor dani; aroma, aroma oil, aroma with timer, navkar mantra, and night lamp burner; decorative and night lamps; home and office decoration lighting products, flowerpots with lighting, and lighting flower vase; vaporizers and camphor sticks; and rolly polly. The company is also involved in the distribution, retailing, and wholesaling of products. It sells its products through outlets and online selling platforms portals, such as India Mart, Amazon, Flipkart, Snapdeal, etc. The company was formerly known as Mayukh Dealtrade Limited and changed its name to Sattva Sukun Lifecare Limited in December 2024. Sattva Sukun Lifecare Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.
